annotation.title_clean: Legal and ethical problems of robotic technologies and artificial intelligence formation and application (using as an example Autonomous Underwater Vehicles – AUV) in modern doctrinal science
annotation.title_en: Legal and ethical problems of robotic technologies and artificial intelligence formation and application (using as an example Autonomous Underwater Vehicles – AUV) in modern doctrinal science
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Mamychev, A.Yu.; Gaivoronskaya, Ya.V.; Miroshnichenko, O.I.
annotation.venue: The Territory of New Opportunities. The Herald of Vladivostok State University of Economics and Service
annotation.summary_en: Russian doctrinal legal article on legal and ethical problems of regulating robotics and AI, using autonomous underwater vehicles as an example. It argues for a dedicated legal and ethical concept, anticipatory legal modelling and standardisation, and says the state that builds an effective legal model can set international standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specific legal regulation of AI and robotics is necessary because the technology is developing rapidly.
Calls for a special legal and ethical concept and anticipatory legal modelling before legislative reform.
Notes the absence of a general legal and ethical framework at both national and international levels.
Cites the EU's October 2017 summit decision to prepare a European legal and ethical concept for robotics and AI in 2018.
A state that develops an effective model can create international legal standards and templates for other countries.
